name: structEvery
description: This function calls a given closure/function with every element in a given struct and returns true, if all of the closure calls returns true.
syntax: structEvery( struct struct, function closure, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description:
function/closure that implements the following constructor

`function(key, value, st){}`

and returns a boolean value

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
